newsitem.title: USA: Andersen Group ups bid on preferred shares.
newsitem.headline: Andersen Group ups bid on preferred shares.

text.p: Andersen Group Inc said Friday it has increased its bid for repurchases of its series A convertible preferred stock to $17 per share from $14 per share.

The company said it has acquired about 24,000 shares since it initiated the repurchase program in November 1996. The company has about 265,000 remaining issued and outstanding shares of preferred stock.
"We have increased the bid for the repurchase of our preferred shares in an effort to provide liquidity for our preferred shareholders," company chairman Francis Baker said in a press release.
The repurchases are being handled primarily through privately negotiated transactions with the firm Stires, O'Donnell & Co Inc, it said.
